name: gpui-telegram-web
description: Full-featured hexagonal TypeScript web edition of bhrum/gpui-telegram with Telegram Web A/K parity

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@gpui-telegram/protocol && npm run build --workspace=@gpui-telegram/server && npm run build --workspace=@gpui-telegram/web
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@gpui-telegram/protocol && npm run dev --workspace=@gpui-telegram/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@gpui-telegram/protocol && npm run build --workspace=@gpui-telegram/server && tsc -p packages/protocol/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.base.json --noEmit
